title: AI + Product Design Morning Brief

highlights.headline: Figma bets on agents.
highlights.summary: [Figma](https://www.figma.com) launched Specs, a Markdown editor for design rules that agents read, and moved code layers to open beta ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/14/figma-announces-new-features-to-define-how-agents-work-on-its-platform)).

highlights.headline: Regulators close in.
highlights.summary: The FTC sent civil investigative demands to [OpenAI](https://www.openai.com) and [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com), and the EU AI Office opened its first AI Act probes into both ([AI Weekly](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/ftc-hits-openai-and-anthropic-with-50-page-civil-investigative-demands-over-ai)).

highlights.headline: Open weights surge.
highlights.summary: [Meta](https://about.meta.com) released Muse Spark Open (816B MoE, 1M context) and [NVIDIA](https://www.nvidia.com) open-sourced Nemotron 3.5 Super VL ([AI Weekly](https://aiweekly.co/ai-news-today)).

highlights.headline: Generative UI goes mainstream.
highlights.summary: ChatGPT now renders charts, buttons and forms inside answers alongside GPT-6 ([AI Weekly](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/openai-launches-chatgpt-intelligent-ui-alongside-gpt-6)).

highlights.headline: Anthropic financials.
highlights.summary: Anthropic reportedly told investors Q3 revenue hit $16.8B, up 45% ([AI Weekly](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/anthropic-tells-investors-q3-revenue-hit-168b-up-45)).

entries.headline: Regulators target OpenAI and Anthropic
entries.summary: The FTC issued 50-page civil investigative demands to both labs over security incidents, safeguards and privacy, and plans to subpoena more firms ([AI Weekly](https://aiweekly.co/ai-news-today)). The EU AI Office opened its first AI Act probes into both ([AI Weekly](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/eu-ai-office-opens-first-ai-act-probes-into-openai-anthropic)). Eight state attorneys general also sued OpenAI over ChatGPT harms to minors ([AI Weekly](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/eight-state-ags-sue-openai-over-chatgpt-child-safety-claims)).
entries.why_it_matters: Compliance requirements will reach product teams. Expect more disclosure, age-gating and logging work in AI features.

entries.headline: Meta and NVIDIA push open weights
entries.summary: Meta's Muse Spark Open is an 816B-parameter MoE with 42B active and a 1M context window ([Meta](https://research.meta.ai/blog/muse-spark-open)). NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a 120B MoE with weights under the OpenMDW license ([VentureBeat](https://venturebeat.com/technology/nvidias-new-open-nemotron-3-5-super-vl-with-post-training-beats-claude-opus-5-gpt-6-1-sol-on-specialized-task-benchmarks)). NVIDIA's benchmark claims are self-reported.
entries.why_it_matters: Strong local and self-hosted models make private prototyping cheaper. Anthropic executives are arguing publicly that open weights carry misuse risk ([Fortune](https://fortune.com/2026/10/15/anthropic-dual-use-ai-defends-oversight-singapore)).

entries.headline: OpenAI: model retirements and ads
entries.summary: OpenAI will retire GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini and GPT-4.1 from its API on Jan 14 ([AI Weekly](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/openai-deprecates-three-image-apis-by-december-2026)). It is also cutting ChatGPT ad prices to court small businesses ([AI Weekly](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/the-information-openai-cuts-chatgpt-ad-prices-and-hires-from-meta-to-court)).
entries.why_it_matters: Audit any product still calling the retiring models. Ads inside AI answers will reshape how users trust conversational UI.

entries.headline: Anthropic: Scion, Singapore and cheaper Haiku
entries.summary: Anthropic open-sourced Scion, a Git replacement built with Claude ([AI Weekly](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/anthropic-builds-scion-to-replace-git-after-merges-hit-30000day)), opened a Singapore office ([AI Weekly](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/anthropic-opens-singapore-office-signs-government-mou)), and cut Claude Haiku 5.5 pricing 75% versus Haiku 4.5 ([AI Weekly](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/anthropic-cuts-claude-haiku-55-price-75-below-haiku-45)). These items come from a news tracker summarizing original reports. Check the primary source before acting on any single claim.
entries.why_it_matters: Cheaper fast models make always-on, in-product AI features economically viable.

entries.headline: Figma Specs and agent context
entries.summary: [Figma](https://www.figma.com) introduced Specs at Config India: a Markdown editor to define a design language, referencing canvas elements, FigJam diagrams and code layers. Teams can centralize design libraries, code libraries and guidelines so agents follow brand rules ([Dataconomy](https://dataconomy.com/2026/10/15/figma-launches-specs-to-guide-ai-with-design-rules)).
entries.why_it_matters: Your design system becomes machine-readable instructions, not just components.

entries.headline: Code layers in open beta, MCP expansion
entries.summary: Code layers add real code to canvas designs for interactive prototypes, and the agent can convert a design to code. Figma added 20+ tools to its MCP, and is integrating the Payload CMS with [Figma Make](https://www.figma.com/make/) ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/14/figma-announces-new-features-to-define-how-agents-work-on-its-platform)).
entries.why_it_matters: Prototypes can carry real logic and content without a handoff.

entries.headline: ChatGPT generative UI
entries.summary: [ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com) now renders charts, buttons and forms in responses ([AI Weekly](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/openai-launches-chatgpt-intelligent-ui-alongside-gpt-6)).
entries.why_it_matters: Designing the components an AI can assemble is becoming a core design task.

entries.headline: Social buzz this run
entries.summary: I could not load [Hacker News](https://news.ycombinator.com) or X live this run, so this section reflects what dominates coverage instead. Open-weight safety versus access is the loudest debate, driven by Anthropic's public stance ([Fortune](https://fortune.com/2026/10/15/anthropic-dual-use-ai-defends-oversight-singapore)). On [Product Hunt](https://www.producthunt.com), agent infrastructure and cost tracking led the week, including [AUDR by Chargebee](https://www.producthunt.com/products/chargebee), an open standard for tracking agent run costs. Many top Product Hunt placements are promoted, so treat rank as weak signal ([weekly leaderboard](https://www.producthunt.com/leaderboard/weekly/2026/41)).

entries.headline: Write a 1-page design spec for an agent
entries.summary: Pick one of your products. Write a Markdown file with your color, spacing, tone and component rules. Give it to [Claude](https://claude.ai) or [Cursor](https://cursor.com) alongside the [Figma](https://www.figma.com) MCP, ask for one screen, and note which rules it ignored. Revise the rules and rerun.

dont_miss: [Figma Specs and code layers](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/14/figma-announces-new-features-to-define-how-agents-work-on-its-platform): the clearest signal of where design tooling is going.
[ChatGPT's generative UI](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/openai-launches-chatgpt-intelligent-ui-alongside-gpt-6): it changes what interface design means.
[OpenAI's Jan 14 model retirements](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/openai-deprecates-three-image-apis-by-december-2026): check your dependencies now.
